verses.gurmukhi: ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਲਖ ਭੋਗ ਚਣੇ ਚਬਾਵਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: hom jag lakh bhog chane chabaavanee|

en.bdb: To feed a Sikh with parched gram is superior to hundreds of thousands of burnt offerings and feasts.
To cause his to be washed is superior to visits to assemblages at the places of pilgrimages.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਲਖ ਜੋਗ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਣਾਵਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: giaan dhiaan lakh jog sabadh sunaavanee|

en.bdb: To repeat to a Sikh of the Gurus hymns is equal to a hundred thousands of other religious exercises.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਹੈ ਨ ਸਹਸਾ ਸੋਗ ਝਾਤੀ ਪਾਵਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: rahai na sahasaa sog jhaatee paavanee|

en.bdb: Even the glimpse of the Guru dispels all doubts and regrets.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਉਜਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਅਰੋਗ ਨ ਲਹਰਿ ਡਰਾਵਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: bhaujal vich arog na lahar ddaraavanee|

en.bdb: Such a man remains unscathed in the terrible world ocean and does not fear its waves.
He whom embraces the Gurus religion (Gurmati) has past beyond the bounds of joy or grief for gain or loss.
